title: Te Whakamātautau o te Wairua Pūmau
intro: E tū ana te wairua i te wā o te whakamātautau atua, e rapu ana i te arataki me te manawanui me te ngākau mahaki. Ko te Mea e mōhio ana ki ngā mea katoa ka panaia tēnei kai rapu, ā, i muri mai ka whakakitea mai he whakamātautau tēnei o te ngākau. Mā roto i tēnei whakawhitiwhiti kōrero ngaro, ka hurahia he akoranga mō te whakaaro nui atua ki te hunga e whakaaroaro ana. Ka taea e koe te tautuhi i tēnei tangata mai i te kōrero a te Quran?
clues: I rapu ahau i te mātauranga me te arataki mai i te karere aroha o Allah
I haere mai ahau ki te rapu i te pono, me te karanga ki te Poropiti me te hiahia nui
I riria ahau, ā, i tahuri ke atu, nā te mea he mahere kē tā te whakaaro nui o Atua mō taua wā.
Heoi, kāore au i ngākau pouri—engari, i haere tonu ahau ki te rapu
I kī te Mea e mōhio ana ki ngā mea katoa he whakamātautau tēnei o te ngākau, he whakatūpato hoki
I roto ahau i te hunga i whakakitea mai e te Quran: 'I pōuri ia, ā, i tahuri ke atu, nā te mea i tae mai te matapo ki a ia'

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Te Tangata Hāngai e Rapu Ana i te Ruarua
Te Kairapu Matapo o te Pono
Te Kaiwhakakara i ngā Whakapakoko o Makkah
Ko te tangata kore whakapono e tawai ana ki te poropiti
Te Kaihaerere mai i Yemen
identity.answer: Te Kairapu Matapo o te Pono

trial.label: Whakamātautau/Takahanga
options: Te riria e te Poropiti a Muhammad i te wā e inoi ana
Te whakamātautau i te tauraki me te matekai i Makkah
Te panaia atu i ngā kūaha o te pararaiha
Te whakakahoretia e te iwi ake mō te whakapono
Te whakamatautauria ki te taonga me ngā tamariki
trial.answer: Te riria e te Poropiti a Muhammad i te wā e inoi ana

location.label: Huānga Matua
options: I roto i te Kaaba i te wā o te haerenga tapu
I te aroaro o te Poropiti i te wā e whakahua ana
I te tihi o Maunga Safa i ngā hāora o te ata
I te mākete o Makkah e karapotia ana e te hunga whakaponokore
E tata ana ki te puna o Zamzam i te wā o te Hajj
location.answer: I te aroaro o te Poropiti i te wā e whakahua ana

outcome.label: Hua
options: I whakamatea te tangata rapu e te hunga Quraysh mō tōna whakapono
I tuhia te aituā hei whakamātautau, hei akoranga hoki mā te Ummah.
I riro te kaitono hei hoa, hei kaiārahi hoki
Tekau ngā whakarea o te taonga o te kaitono
I hoki te kaiwhai ki te kore whakapono
outcome.answer: I tuhia te aituā hei whakamātautau, hei akoranga hoki mā te Ummah.
